Name: Qi to Concerned Ape
Author: RandomPlayer2
Description:
This mod replaces sprites, portraits, dialog, and item names. 

This is my first mod ever and I'm new to making pixel art. I made this mod because I thought it would be a cool change for the summit scene. (I have to admit it's kind of scary because my pixel art looks a bit lifeless but maybe that adds to the charm.)

If there is any mention of Mr Qi that I missed changing, let me know.

The only things I didn't change is the look of the Qi related items. If people actually like this mod I'll work on changing those too.-

Manifest.Name: Qi to Concerned Ape
Manifest.Description: Replaces Mr Qi with Concerned ape.
